autostorager.page.what: Drop a print file into a folder and it shows up in Storage, ready to print.
autostorager.page.delay: The folder is checked every few seconds. A file is only taken once it has stopped growing.
autostorager.page.names: If the name is already in Storage, the file gets -1, -2 and so on. Nothing is overwritten.
autostorager.page.docker: Running the server in a container? The folder has to be reachable inside it.
autostorager.page.no: leave the source where it is
autostorager.page.folderHint: The folder as the server sees it.
autostorager.page.maxHint: In megabytes. A bigger one goes to failed/ instead.
autostorager.page.precedence: Changes are saved right away and kept after a restart.
